Athlete Finishes Hyrox Race After Fecal Incontinence Incident

An athlete competing in the Hyrox Beijing race experienced fecal incontinence during the event but continued and finished. The incident led to the race organizer disinfecting the course. The athlete stated that 'win is a win' despite the circumstances. Reports indicate this type of incident is becoming more common in the sport.
